direction.grid: 100vw x 100dvh overflow:hidden; rows 48px header / 44px guide / minmax(0,1fr) main / 56px action bar; at 1366x768 use 184px step rail / minmax(0,1fr) stage / 360px inspector; stage minimum 55vw x 60vh; no page scroll, internal scroll only in inspector and task lists; refit tight panels before reducing type; all targets at least 36px
direction.colorTokens: bg #050705, panel #0B100B, raised #121A12, border rgba(197,204,212,.22); silver #C5CCD4 for headings and machine bodies, silverDim rgba(197,204,212,.68); primary neon #A8F04A with #050705 text, one primary per viewport; stoppedRed #E5484D reserved exclusively for stopped CELL-MILL-2 outline, cross-hatch and OFFLINE-STOPPED text; official logo immutable black, emerald/neon green and brushed silver at native aspect in exactly two placements: header and opening story, never recolored, cropped, redrawn or duplicated elsewhere
direction.typography: System sans; 24/30 stage title, 15/20 panel title, 13/19 body, 11/14 uppercase micro-labels, 26px tabular metrics; one verb-led instruction and one status sentence per step; minimal narration; enlarge any stage label under 11px to 11px minimum
direction.motion: 160-220ms ease-out for selection and panels; one 240ms route trace on real state change, then static; no loops or pulses; prefers-reduced-motion removes transitions while pattern, marker and text still carry meaning; 2px neon focus ring with 2px offset on every interactive element; pointer style only on enabled controls
direction.components: Header 48px with official logo left and Lock recovery room right; opening story carries the second and final logo placement; vertical step rail from one steps array with aria-current, arrow-key movement and 36-40px targets, replacing the clipped horizontal scroller; guide strip with no duplicate primary; focusable cinematic factory stage SVG; inspector 360px keeping pre-flight route-health checks for nonce and identity visually and semantically separate from the distinct investigation evidence task, with separate headings, status and controls; action bar 56px with Back left, status centre and one primary right; selecting a recovery option opens the typed consent form; skip-to-stage first, then header, rail, guide, SVG nodes, inspector and action bar in tab order; Enter/Space activate, Esc closes, aria-live polite announces results only
direction.visualizations: State-driven 960x540 SVG using real state only: MAT-ALLOY-A held, 40+30=70 units, feasible routes only in neon, silver for idle machines, red only for stopped CELL-MILL-2, never a route through the offline cell; aligned Certificate 120 versus Receiving 80 tracks with DOES NOT MATCH spanning the gap inside the stage bounds; bidirectional SVG-to-inspector highlighting; persistent Running/Held/Blocked/Offline-Stopped/Feasible-Accepted legend using pattern, marker and text; pending task proposals deliberately untracked until human approval, while blocked prior tasks remain visible beside an approved recovery plan as replacement tasks await approval

Separate ROUTE HEALTH PRE-FLIGHT nonce/identity status from INVESTIGATION SOURCE EVIDENCE with distinct headings, borders and controls; never merge their status text.
Fix overlapping DOCK, MAT-ALLOY-A, QA and Receiving labels on SVG by refitting node geometry and moving labels into clear gutters.
Remove third logo instance from stage header; retain only header and opening story placements.
Keep selected option opening the typed consent form in inspector, with exact-phrase field labelled, character count announced, and Accept disabled until matched.
Give the three path cards equal height, right-aligned 26px finish/cost metrics, and a visible 2px focus ring on Select controls.
Fix overlapping evidence captions beneath the SVG and enlarge route option text to 11px minimum.
Reduce duplicated proposal detail between stage and inspector; stage shows t1-t3 summary chips, inspector shows full untracked-until-approval proposal.
Move Review proposed tasks and Decline proposal out of the inspector footer duplication and keep one primary Approve in the 56px action bar.
Add a visible focus ring and 36px height to task chips 1, 2, 3 and to t1/t2/t3 stage selectors.
Refit the capacity preview callout so Apply arrow, 24h to 0h and MAT-ALLOY-B route label do not overlap machine nodes or flow lines.
Make preview state for CELL-MILL-2 use silver dashed preview styling, reserving stoppedRed for the actually stopped state in later steps.
Shorten inspector scenario copy to one instruction plus one consequence sentence, keeping the primary Apply second shock in the action bar only.
Preserve stoppedRed exclusively on CELL-MILL-2 outline, hatch and OFFLINE-STOPPED text; ensure no route line passes through that cell.
Keep pre-flight nonce/identity checks separate above the distinct investigation evidence task, each with its own run status.
Fix overlapping Certificate says / Receiving counted / Substitute captions and dashed connector collisions around JOB-1001.
Keep constrained Split path hatched with text reason and no finish/cost values, while feasible paths retain aligned metrics.
Enlarge consent helper text to 11px minimum and associate exact-phrase label, input and 0/27 count programmatically.
Keep PRIOR ACCEPTANCE INVALIDATED status centred in action bar and disabled Accept visually distinct without relying on colour alone.
Keep 3 BLOCKED prior tasks visibly separate from 3 PROPOSED replacements, stating blocked prior tasks and approved recovery plan coexist while replacements await approval.
Refit blocked list inside inspector without internal scrollbar at 1366x768 by tightening row padding before reducing type.
Truncate action-bar status with full text available via title and aria-label, keeping Approve revised tasks fully visible.
Keep Verify ledger as the sole primary until enabled sequence advances; locked Seal and Retain cards need lock text plus pattern, not colour alone.
Make inspector steps 1-3 collapsible sections keyboard operable with aria-expanded and 36px targets.
Align BEFORE-AFTER metrics 70, 35h and 48h on one baseline with 11px uppercase labels.
Add a final status summary in action bar already present, and ensure Back does not imply further primary action; add a clearly labelled Close or Return control if exit is available in real state.
Keep all three SEALED cards equal size with check, title and state text, and retain red only on the retained offline CELL-MILL-2 reference.
Remove horizontal step scroller clipping in favour of the vertical rail so completion state for all steps is visible without scrolling.
